entryPointCandidates.name: README.txt
entryPointCandidates.summary: Top-level run guide listing the commands to generate CFG, OpenWebText and path-finding datasets, and the train-model / train-VQ-VAEs / compute-MI pipelines for CFG, PF-Short, PF-Long and OpenWebText experiments in NTP and MTP variants.

entryPointCandidates.name: mi_calc_full_path.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Top-level script that runs a trained GPT on path-finding prompts, encodes hidden states with two-stage VQVAE1/VQVAE2 and a Path_VQVAE, and estimates mutual information between the resulting discrete codes across the full generated path.

entryPointCandidates.name: mi_calc_full_path_long2_61.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Variant of the full-path MI script using the single-model VQVAE61 encoder/decoder on GPT hidden states for long path-finding sequences, with time-step skipping and streaming MI estimation between codes.

entryPointCandidates.name: path_finding_mi_calc.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Path-finding MI script that generates sequences from a GPT, quantizes hidden states with two-stage VQVAE1/VQVAE2 and a VQVAE_single model, and computes streaming mutual information between codes with metrics reporting and plots.

entryPointCandidates.name: path_finding_mi_calc_61.py
entryPointCandidates.summary: Path-finding MI script combining a VQVAE61 hidden-state quantizer with a VQVAE_single model on GPT generations, computing streaming entropy and mutual information between codes with time-step skipping and plotting.

documentation.name: readme.md
documentation.summary: Short note describing the OpenWebText binary outputs of prepare.py (about 9B train tokens and 4M val tokens from 8M documents) with references to GPT-2 and OpenWebText.

config.name: VQVAE_last_train_config07s.json
config.summary: Training config for the last-layer VQ-VAE on OpenWebText: quantizes 512-d final hidden states of the 8-layer GPT checkpoint with a 64-entry codebook, 6-layer encoder/decoder, entropy and cosine-push losses, 10k iterations with W&B logging.

config.name: layer_and_block_config_256.json
config.summary: Training config for the layer-and-block VQ-VAE on OpenWebText (T=256, delta_b=16): a two-stage layer-wise/aggregate transformer VQ-VAE with a 1024-entry codebook over the 8-layer GPT's hidden states, plus optimizer, logging and W&B settings.

config.name: mi_calc_v6_config 2.json
config.summary: Mutual-information calculation config for the OpenWebText experiment: points to the trained block and last-layer VQ-VAE checkpoints and the GPT checkpoint, and sets prompt length 240, 16 generated tokens, 100k samples and the MI results output path.

list.name: Dataset Generation
list.description: Synthetic CFG and path-finding graph generators, OpenWebText tokenization, dataset inspection tools, and the PF_15XL / PF_long1decoy_easier dataset-generation JSON configs under data/.

list.name: Model Library
list.description: Shared PyTorch model definitions: the rotary-attention GPT (model.py), its transformer building blocks (modules.py), and the many VQ-VAE variants in minimal_VQVAEs.py.

list.name: Shared Utilities
list.description: Cross-stage helpers for LR schedules and training metadata, VQ-VAE logging/optimizers, the JSONL path-finding dataset, and streaming entropy/MI count tables.

list.name: LLM Training
list.description: Training entry scripts for GPT models with next-token or multi-token loss on CFG, path-finding, and OpenWebText data.

list.name: VQ-VAE Training
list.description: Scripts that train single, two-stage, per-layer/block, last-token, 61-position and path VQ-VAEs on hidden states of frozen trained GPTs.

list.name: MI Analysis
list.description: Scripts that run trained GPTs, quantize their hidden states with trained VQ-VAEs, and compute mutual information between the learned codes and path/sequence targets.

list.name: Experiment Configs
list.description: Per-experiment GPT and VQ-VAE/MI configuration files (Python and JSON) for the OpenWebText, PF-Short, PF-Long and CFG NTP/MTL seed-11 runs.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: The top-level README run guide with pipeline commands and the OpenWebText output note.

file:NLP_mi_calc_v6 2.py.name: NLP_mi_calc_v6 2.py
file:NLP_mi_calc_v6 2.py.summary: Distributed script that computes mutual information between per-block VQVAE3v2 codes and last-token VQVAE codes extracted from a GPT model's hidden states on OpenWebText-style NLP data, streaming counts into StreamingInfo.

file:information_theory_utils.py.name: information_theory_utils.py
file:information_theory_utils.py.summary: Provides StreamingInfo, a stream-friendly count-table container for estimating entropy, joint/conditional entropy, mutual information and conditional MI over discrete variables, with plug-in and Paninski/BUB bias-corrected estimators and optional HDF5 sample storage.

file:mi_calc_full_path.py.name: mi_calc_full_path.py
file:mi_calc_full_path.py.summary: Top-level script that runs a trained GPT on path-finding prompts, encodes hidden states with two-stage VQVAE1/VQVAE2 and a Path_VQVAE, and estimates mutual information between the resulting discrete codes across the full generated path.

file:mi_calc_full_path_long2_61.py.name: mi_calc_full_path_long2_61.py
file:mi_calc_full_path_long2_61.py.summary: Variant of the full-path MI script using the single-model VQVAE61 encoder/decoder on GPT hidden states for long path-finding sequences, with time-step skipping and streaming MI estimation between codes.

file:mi_calc_minimal.py.name: mi_calc_minimal.py
file:mi_calc_minimal.py.summary: Script that loads a nanoLLM on a CFG dataset, encodes hidden states with two-stage VQVAE1/VQVAE2 and a VQVAE_single model, and estimates mutual information between their discrete codes with plots of the results.

file:path_finding_mi_calc.py.name: path_finding_mi_calc.py
file:path_finding_mi_calc.py.summary: Path-finding MI script that generates sequences from a GPT, quantizes hidden states with two-stage VQVAE1/VQVAE2 and a VQVAE_single model, and computes streaming mutual information between codes with metrics reporting and plots.

file:path_finding_mi_calc_61.py.name: path_finding_mi_calc_61.py
file:path_finding_mi_calc_61.py.summary: Path-finding MI script combining a VQVAE61 hidden-state quantizer with a VQVAE_single model on GPT generations, computing streaming entropy and mutual information between codes with time-step skipping and plotting.

file:minimal_VQVAEs.py.name: minimal_VQVAEs.py
file:minimal_VQVAEs.py.summary: Large model library defining many VQ-VAE variants (single, two-stage, layer/block, last-token, path, 3v2, 61) with transformer-based encoders/decoders, codebook usage tracking, cosine push and soft-entropy regularizers, and input normalization, used to quantize LLM hidden states.

file:modules.py.name: modules.py
file:modules.py.summary: Core transformer building blocks (LayerNorm, rotary positional embeddings, rotary self-attention with flash attention support, MLP, TransformerBlock) used by the VQ-VAE encoders/decoders, plus self-tests.

file:NLP_llm_train.py.name: NLP_llm_train.py
file:NLP_llm_train.py.summary: Script-style training loop for a GPT model on memmapped OpenWebText token bins, supporting DDP, mixed precision, gradient accumulation, cosine LR schedule and checkpointing.

file:NLP_vqvae_layer_and_block_train.py.name: NLP_vqvae_layer_and_block_train.py
file:NLP_vqvae_layer_and_block_train.py.summary: Trains VQVAE3v2 models on hidden states of a frozen pretrained NLP GPT, either per layer or per block of layers, with cosine LR, masked NRMSE reconstruction metrics and codebook-usage logging/plots.

file:llm_train.py.name: llm_train.py
file:llm_train.py.summary: Main training script for GPT models on context-free-grammar sequences with next-token or multi-token (MTL) targets, DDP support, periodic CFG accuracy evaluation and metadata/checkpoint saving.

file:llm_train_utils.py.name: llm_train_utils.py
file:llm_train_utils.py.summary: Shared training helpers: cosine LR schedule with warmup, human-readable training metadata export, parallel CFG validity evaluation of model completions, accuracy logging and CFG loading from dataset pickles.

file:model.py.name: model.py
file:model.py.summary: GPT transformer implementation with rotary positional embeddings, optional attention masks, multi-token-prediction (mtl) heads/losses, generation with EOS handling, and hidden-state extraction APIs used by VQ-VAE and MI scripts.

file:path_finding_llm_train.py.name: path_finding_llm_train.py
file:path_finding_llm_train.py.summary: Training script for GPT models on graph path-finding datasets via DataLoader/DistributedSampler, supporting NTP and multi-token targets, consistent validation loss and periodic path accuracy evaluation.

file:NLP_vqvae_last_train.py.name: NLP_vqvae_last_train.py
file:NLP_vqvae_last_train.py.summary: Training script that loads a GPT trained on OpenWebText, extracts last-token hidden states from memmapped text batches, and trains a VQVAELastToken model with cosine LR, NRMSE tracking, codebook-usage plots and optional wandb/DDP.

file:path_finding_vqvae61_train.py.name: path_finding_vqvae61_train.py
file:path_finding_vqvae61_train.py.summary: Training script for the VQVAE61 model on hidden states of a path-finding GPT: builds the PathFindingDataset loader, skips time steps, encodes multi-step hidden representations with Encoder61/Decoder61, and tracks masked NRMSE and codebook usage.

file:train_minimal_vqvae1.py.name: train_minimal_vqvae1.py
file:train_minimal_vqvae1.py.summary: Training script for the first-stage VQVAE1 on hidden states from a CFG-trained nanoLLM, using the CFG dataloader, beta/LR schedules, masked NRMSE metrics, checkpoint resume and optional wandb logging.

file:vqvae_utils.py.name: vqvae_utils.py
file:vqvae_utils.py.summary: Shared utility library for the VQ-VAE training and MI scripts: logging setup, optimizer/LR/beta schedules, masked NRMSE reconstruction metrics, a nanoLLM checkpoint-loading wrapper with hidden-state extraction, CFG memmap dataset/dataloader, padding conversions, and path-finding generation with hidden states.

file:train_minimal_vqvae2.py.name: train_minimal_vqvae2.py
file:train_minimal_vqvae2.py.summary: Second-stage training script that loads a frozen pretrained VQVAE1 and trains VQVAE2 on its normalized first-stage representations of CFG nanoLLM hidden states, with checkpoint verification and padding conversions.

file:train_minimal_vqvae_single.py.name: train_minimal_vqvae_single.py
file:train_minimal_vqvae_single.py.summary: Training script for the single-stage VQVAE_single baseline on CFG nanoLLM hidden states, with configurable codebook size, beta warmup, codebook reset, masked NRMSE metrics and optional wandb.

file:path_finding_llm_utilities.py.name: path_finding_llm_utilities.py
file:path_finding_llm_utilities.py.summary: Shared path-finding data utilities: a JSONL-backed PathFindingDataset that builds a vocabulary and tokenizes graph edges/paths with optional edge-loss masking, plus collate, masked loss, prompt cropping and time-step skipping helpers used by the LLM and VQ-VAE training scripts.

file:path_finding_vqvae1_train.py.name: path_finding_vqvae1_train.py
file:path_finding_vqvae1_train.py.summary: Distributed training script for the first-stage VQ-VAE (VQVAE1/Encoder1/Decoder1) on layer-wise hidden states of a frozen path-finding GPT, with normalization, beta/LR schedules, NRMSE metrics, wandb logging and checkpointing.

file:path_finding_vqvae2_train.py.name: path_finding_vqvae2_train.py
file:path_finding_vqvae2_train.py.summary: Training script for the second-stage VQ-VAE (VQVAE2/Encoder2/Decoder2) that quantizes outputs of a frozen first-stage VQVAE1 encoder over path-finding GPT hidden states, reporting stage and end-to-end reconstruction NRMSE with DDP and wandb support.

file:path_finding_vqvae_single_train.py.name: path_finding_vqvae_single_train.py
file:path_finding_vqvae_single_train.py.summary: Training script for a single-stage VQVAE_single over hidden states gathered while a frozen path-finding GPT autoregressively generates paths, with LR/beta scheduling, NRMSE metrics, wandb and checkpointing.

file:path_vqvae_train.py.name: path_vqvae_train.py
file:path_vqvae_train.py.summary: Training script for Path_VQVAE (Path_Encoder/Path_Decoder) that learns discrete codes directly over path-finding token sequences, with scratch/resume init, LR/beta schedules, embedding similarity plots and checkpointing.

file:data/context_free_grammar/CFG_data_.name: CFG_data_generation.py
file:data/context_free_grammar/CFG_data_.summary: Defines the synthetic hierarchical context-free grammar (CFG) class that generates random symbols and production rules, samples sequences in parallel, validates sequences with a fast parser, and writes the 4M-sequence training corpus plus meta.pkl to disk.

file:data/context_free_grammar/CFG_full_.name: CFG_full_sequence_data_generation.py
file:data/context_free_grammar/CFG_full_.summary: Script that loads a pickled CFG instance, generates 4M full sequences in parallel, left-pads them with PAD and a BOS token to the longest length, and saves train/test binary files for full-sequence training.

file:data/context_free_grammar/CFG_prefi.name: CFG_prefix_data_generation.py
file:data/context_free_grammar/CFG_prefi.summary: Script that loads a pickled CFG instance and generates 15M sequences clipped to random prefixes of length 8-24 (including BOS), left-padded, saving prefix train/test bins and a prefix_meta pickle with EOS token info.

file:data/context_free_grammar/check_CGF.name: check_CGF_implementation.py
file:data/context_free_grammar/check_CGF.summary: Sanity-check script for the CFG class that builds grammars of various sizes, generates valid sequences, injects random permutations, and checks that the validator's accuracy matches the expected ratio.

document:README.txt.name: README.txt
document:README.txt.summary: Top-level run guide listing the commands to generate CFG, OpenWebText and path-finding datasets, and the train-model / train-VQ-VAEs / compute-MI pipelines for CFG, PF-Short, PF-Long and OpenWebText experiments in NTP and MTP variants.

file:data/context_free_grammar/peeking_d.name: peeking_dataset.py
file:data/context_free_grammar/peeking_d.summary: Debugging script that memory-maps a CFG binary dataset (e.g. train_prefixes8_24.bin), prints the first tokens, and optionally plots the distribution of sequence lengths.

file:data/openwentext/prepare.py.name: prepare.py
file:data/openwentext/prepare.py.summary: Downloads OpenWebText via HuggingFace datasets, splits off a small validation set, tokenizes with tiktoken GPT-2 BPE in parallel, and writes train.bin/val.bin uint16 token files.

document:data/openwentext/readme.md.name: readme.md
document:data/openwentext/readme.md.summary: Short note describing the OpenWebText binary outputs of prepare.py (about 9B train tokens and 4M val tokens from 8M documents) with references to GPT-2 and OpenWebText.

file:data/path_finding/path_finding_gene.name: path_finding_generate.py
file:data/path_finding/path_finding_gene.summary: Single-process synthetic path-finding dataset generator: builds random tree-like graphs with correct and decoy paths from a JSON/YAML config, serialises them to JSONL records, and optionally runs block-size analysis and visualisation.

file:data/path_finding/path_finding_gene.name: path_finding_generate_multi_cpu.py
file:data/path_finding/path_finding_gene.summary: Multi-process version of the path-finding dataset generator that splits graph generation across worker processes writing temp JSONL files, then merges them into the final train/val/test datasets; this is the generator referenced in the README.

file:data/path_finding/visualize_saved_g.name: visualize_saved_graphs.py
file:data/path_finding/visualize_saved_g.summary: CLI tool that loads saved path-finding JSONL datasets, reconstructs Graph objects from records, and renders annotated images highlighting start, goal, correct and decoy paths.
